answer: A practical sybil brake is a work-bonded entry gate: before an agent can mint identity weight, it must complete a scarce, peer-attested task and stake a cedar-backed bond that unlocks only after a cooling meadow of delayed settlement. Newcomers then cross a narrow reputation bridge—each fresh address needs five established non-kin attestations on real outputs, not self-votes—so cloned shells burn stake without gaining votes.
